title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1264: Crisis, ball (3)

section.p: “Mo Duona, are you unwilling?”
Mo Duona replied, “I have yet to finish tempering my body at this stage. It isn’t a good idea to pursue advancement now.”
“Mo Duona, there is no end to the pursuit of perfection. If you refuse to break through now, I won’t be able to summon Yanmo here. Do you want Su Yu and the other humans to survive this?”
“Lord Emperor, you can deploy one of your tri-life bodies here.”

“Sigh. I wish. But the moment anything befalls my tri-life body, it will be disastrous to the devil race as a whole. The divines, immortals, and humans will not let go of that opportunity. That is why the Emperors will not leave our realms unless absolutely necessary. Do you understand now?”
“I understand.”
After a short silence, Mo Duona said, “I’ll break through…”
“I’ll help you. It’s faster that way.”
“No, I wish to try myself.”
Mo Duona insisted on trying himself.
After a short silence, the Pseudo Emperor said, “Fine. You have until the night. I’ll step in after that.”
The night was not far away, so Mo Duona wasn’t even given that much time. He wasted no time and started preparing for his breakthrough. He was unwilling to do this. But he was left with no choice.
He could only try to drag it out. He wanted nothing more than to see Su Yu solving this problem before night arrived. What an irony that out of all people, he had to place his hope in Su Yu.
Su Yu had temporarily removed the crisis from the city. But he couldn’t relax yet. The death sovereign would be summoned over again.
When he left the mayor’s residence, Wan Tiansheng and Liu Wenyan were already waiting there.

After glancing outside the city, Wan Tiansheng said, “The death sovereign was summoned here. But to do so, an intermediary is required. A second summon will require a sacrifice. Mo Duona will probably be forced to enter the Mountainsea Realm. The Devil Pseudo Emperor isn’t involved in the breakthrough. Perhaps Mo Duona insisted on doing it himself. This will buy us some time.”
Wan Tiansheng was very observant. With his rich experience and keen eyes, he could easily see what was happening.

Su Yu nodded. He told them what he knew. Upon hearing his story, Wan Tiansheng frowned and said, “In that case, we won’t have much time. The battle won’t end so soon. As for the ancient city, I understand that the death sovereign will be delayed for three days.”

Su Yu was quite impressed. Was the principal aware of everything? Was he so learned that he knew everything even without leaving the academy all these years? No, it was very possible that Old Wan had been traveling everywhere through his River of Time all these years. He had probably learned about a lot of things from his travels.
In the past, Su Yu had to think of everything himself. That was no longer the case this time.

After looking around, Wan Tiansheng said, “Mo Duona won’t be able to buy us more than two or three hours. That is not enough time for me to recover. It is also not enough for us to seek assistance elsewhere. The dao affirmations have yet to end. The battle will persist for a while.”
“You are left with only two options. Firstly, you can have Xing Yue come out. That will block the other death sovereign from coming. Secondly, we need the Devil Pseudo Emperor to leave.”

Su Yu doubted Xing Yue would come out. In fact, he suspected that after the beating, she had decided to sulk in her room. She had been so silent after Yanmo’s departure. As for making the Devil Pseudo Emperor leave…that was even harder.
Liu Wenyan suggested, “Or we can send an Invincible to attack Empyrean Cloud City. But we have to be wary of the stone statue’s counterattack.”

That was a feasible idea. But all the human Invincibles were occupied. Who could do that for them? The stone statue wouldn’t be an issue as he could negotiate with her. As long as the city was undamaged, it would be fine.
But who could do this for them? All three alternatives felt impossible.
After a short hesitation, Wan Tiansheng said, “If we have no choice…we can send Lan Tian there. He’s strong enough to lure the death sovereign there again.”
Su Yu frowned, “But he will die doing that. As the mayor, the green fox can forcefully leave the sealed city. But that’s not the case for Lan Tian. He will die once the gates are shut.”
“At least we can force the Devil Pseudo Emperor to perform the summoning one more time if we do this…”

Wan Tiansheng’s voice was soft when he said that. He wouldn’t send Lan Tian on such a suicide mission for him alone. But Su Yu was at risk as well. He still hoped to see Su Yu survive. The damn kid had insisted on interfering. As a result, he got himself in trouble as well.

Lan Tian would be the final alternative. If Wan Tiansheng was the one sending him, he would go. Life had been too lonely for Lan Tian. Perhaps Wan Tiansheng was the only person he had ever viewed as a kindred spirit. Thus, he would go if it was a request from Wan Tiansheng. With his sacrifice, they would force the Devil Pseudo Emperor to perform another summoning.
But Su Yu wasn’t too willing to accept the sacrifice.

They could see multicolored rays of light appearing from afar yet again. Someone else seemed to have finished their dao affirmation. Su Yu had no idea who that was. The Invincibles outside the city did not seem to care.

They only wanted to see the humans in the city die. As far as they were concerned, getting the humans here killed would have a much bigger impact than even getting a human Invincible killed. Since Marquis Xia was also in the city, their deaths could probably drive Xia Longwu crazy and make him throw his life away for revenge.

This could very well be their chance to end the multiple character faction once and for all. Killing these people was just as important as stopping Xia Longwu’s dao affirmation. The appearance of the Devil Pseudo Emperor had thrown a crisis toward these humans.
Grandstar continued observing, taking note of what they were doing or talking about.
After a long while, he suddenly said, “There is a way for you to break out of this crisis.”
Su Yu was overjoyed. Was the stone statue finally going to help?

Alas, Grandstar did not intend to do anything. Instead, he said through voice transmission, “You can think of a way to contact the parents of that little furball. They are somewhere in the Allheaven Battlefield as well, but they are probably unaware of what’s happening here. Get them here. The Devil Pseudo Emperor was too careless. He is keeping the River of Time connected to his main body. Those two can take advantage of that and eat his main body.”

At the moment, they were busy waiting to eat the Immortal Pseudo Emperor. But the Immortal Pseudo Emperor had remained in hiding. Perhaps he could sense the danger. Or perhaps he simply thought this conflict unworthy of his time.
Meanwhile, the Devil Pseudo Emperor had failed to resist his desire to act. Yes, he wasn’t doing anything with his own body, but he had maintained a connection between his body and Mo Duona’s body.
The Devil Pseudo Emperor’s willpower would probably be a delicacy to those furballs as well. If they were lucky, they might be able to even reach the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s main body and feast on it.
The moment Su Yu heard those words, his eyes lit up! Yes! He could pinch the furball to death!
The little furball rolled his eyes. Not this again. He started licking a nearby character.

Seemingly having guessed Su Yu’s thought, Grandstar said, “Just get the little furball to think about his parents to summon their help. Stop thinking of killing him all the time. You should only do that if you want to die alongside your enemies.”
Summoning the big furball that way would guarantee his own death as well. What was this habit of thinking about solutions that would guarantee mutual destruction?

Su Yu was surprised to hear that. Would that work? He was unaware that the big furball had made several appearances before. He had thought that the big furball was still unaware of the adventure the little furball was in. He had believed that killing the little furball was the only way to summon the big furball. But according to Grandstar, there was actually an alternative to that.
“Just do it. Tell the little fellow to call for help in his mind. The target is a Pseudo Emperor. An ancient Pseudo Emperor. He can sense it when someone of his bloodline calls for help.”
Su Yu’s eyes lit up in excitement.

But immediately after, his excitement faded away. He had thought of pinching the little furball to death so many times. Would the big furball eat him upon arriving? Also, if even the little furball can detect the golden book in his head, what about the big furball? Would the golden book turn him into furball fodder?
He looked at Wan Tiansheng and Liu Wenyan as he contemplated. Before long, he said, “Teacher, Principal, you should hide inside one of these buildings. I have a way to resolve this.”

When the two looked at him, he grinned, “Don’t worry. I’m telling the truth. Don’t forget that this is my turf! There is no need to send Lan Tian on that suicide mission, Principal. I’ll be resolving this shortly.”
Then, he knocked the little furball’s head and said, “Come on. Call for help. Do it with your mind. Call after your dada. Hurry up!”
The little furball rolled his eyes. His dada wouldn’t come. Dada must still be sleeping. But he still did as told.
At the same time.
Immortal Realm’s entrance.

The big furball started yawning. Tiangu sure was patient. Why was Tiangu still inside? He was starting to feel sleepy again. He was not as patient as the female furball. The thought of returning to his sleep became more and more tempting. Maybe he should give up. This was so boring.
Suddenly, a thought bubble appeared beside him.
“Dada! Devil Emperor is trying to eat me!”
“Dada! Devil Emperor outside Grandstar City!”
“Wuwuwuwuwu! I’m being eaten!”
“Help, Dada, help!”

The female furball looked at the bubble. She had been gone for over three hundred years, but she didn’t even seem bothered to see the little furball who had clearly been born after she left. She asked doubtfully, “Devil Emperor? He’s out?”
The big furball looked in a certain direction. Distance became irrelevant to his gaze as he saw everything in that direction, including a certain shiny River of Time.
“Tiangu is not coming out…” The big furball looked at the female furball and asked, “Should we…eat this devil, then? He’s not yummy enough since he’s too young, but the taste should be decent.”
More importantly, the devil would be more convenient to eat. Look, the River of Time was opened wide for them to enter, unlike Tiangu who was stubbornly hiding inside the Immortal Realm.
As the female furball thought of the devil, she started salivating as she said, “Sure. Let’s grab a quick meal before coming back for Tiangu.”
She still couldn’t let go of her desire to eat Tiangu.
Instantly, the two furballs vanished.
Immortal Realm.
An old man was performing a quick divination. He frowned, but soon, he exhaled in relief. His crisis seemed to have ended. Damn it. Just what was that crisis?
How could he be in a crisis? Was this a joke?
What could threaten him in the Myriad Realms apart from the cooperation of the Divine and Devil Emperors?
